pages.text: That is the beginning. The rest of the $(thing)Discovery$() map runs left to right in the order things are met, each chapter linked to what it builds on; locked chapters show as $(thing)???$() until their research is done. The other tabs sort the same pages by branch (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Mathematics), by world (Dimensions) and by kind (Materials, Creatures, Machines).

Habits that help:$(li)Press $(thing)K$() over any item in an inventory to see how it is made.$(li)Check $(thing)Next steps$() whenever you have new Insight.$(li)Every tier has a thought experiment for Insight: build each tier's thinking machine.$(li)Storage blocks are woven, not packed: they cannot be taken apart again.
